name: Johnny Wills
caption: LVWF Commissioner who draws the ten-way dance field from a ball hopper on the fed's first Era 3 broadcast; billed the same night as a current DPW announcer.

identity.note: No other Johnny Wills-named character is on file; recorded as its own record pending any future collision.

name: Psycho Gil
caption: Lost the opening match of LVWF's first Era 3 broadcast to "Wing-Man" Tyler James, pinned after a top-rope splash.

identity.note: No other Psycho Gil-named character is on file; recorded as its own record pending any future collision.

name: "Wing-Man" Tyler James
caption: Won LVWF's first Era 3 opener over Psycho Gil with a top-rope splash he calls the Helli-Kitty.

identity.note: No other Tyler James-named character is on file; recorded as its own record pending any future collision.

name: The Stud Muffin
caption: Won the ten-way dance on LVWF's first Era 3 broadcast to become the first LVWF Television Champion, pinning The Terminator with a top-rope clothesline he calls the decapitator.

identity.note: Shares a name with the held VWA (Virtual, 1995) character Stud Muffin; no shared operator, roster, or cross-narrating document ties the two, and generic ring-gimmick names were widely reused across unrelated feds in this hobby -- recorded distinct, not merged, on name alone.

name: The Terminator
caption: Eliminated John Shaft and Billy "The Man" Magma and chokeslammed The Loose Cannon out of the ten-way dance before losing the fall to The Stud Muffin.

identity.note: "The Terminator"/"Terminator" is one of this hobby's most widely reused generic ring names; no shared operator, roster, or cross-narrating document ties this LVWF persona to any of the other held same-named characters -- recorded distinct, not merged, on name alone.

name: The Loose Cannon
caption: Eliminated Union Caine and Static Rule in the ten-way dance before being chokeslammed to the floor by The Terminator.

identity.note: Shares a name with the held CWF Pro character 'the Loose Cannon'; no shared operator, roster, or cross-narrating document ties the two -- recorded distinct, not merged, on name alone.

name: Tornado
caption: Eliminated The Wrecking Machine to open the ten-way dance before being eliminated himself in a brawl to the back with Slick Vick.

identity.note: Shares a name with the held NFW character Tornado and is close to the held RSPWF character Tornado Warrior; no shared operator, roster, or cross-narrating document ties any of them -- recorded distinct, not merged, on name alone.

name: The Wrecking Machine
caption: First man eliminated from LVWF's first ten-way dance, rolled up by Tornado after a distraction from The Loose Cannon.

identity.note: No other Wrecking Machine-named character is on file; recorded as its own record pending any future collision.

name: John Shaft
caption: Eliminated from the ten-way dance by The Terminator after a dropkick had no effect.

identity.note: Shares a name with the held EUWC character John Shaft; no shared operator, roster, or cross-narrating document ties the two -- recorded distinct, not merged, on name alone.

name: "The Ultimate Heel" Union Caine
caption: Eliminated from the ten-way dance by The Loose Cannon.

identity.note: No other Union Caine-named character is on file; recorded as its own record pending any future collision.

name: Static Rule
caption: Eliminated from the ten-way dance, powerbombed and pinned by The Loose Cannon.

identity.note: Shares a name with two held characters (CWC Continental, RSPWF); no shared operator, roster, or cross-narrating document ties this LVWF persona to either -- recorded distinct, not merged, on name alone.

name: Slick Vick
caption: Eliminated Tornado in the ten-way dance in a brawl to the back that carried both men out of the match.

identity.note: No other Slick Vick-named character is on file; recorded as its own record pending any future collision.

name: Billy "The Man" Magma
caption: Eliminated from the ten-way dance, kicked and DDT'd for the pin by The Terminator.

identity.note: No other Billy Magma-named character is on file; recorded as its own record pending any future collision. The document itself spells the surname both 'Magma' and 'Magna'; 'Magma' is used here as the more frequent form and both spellings stand as written on the served page.
